[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 13:07

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Canasta is a rummy-type card game for two to six players, played with two standard decks of cards plus four jokers (a total of 108 cards).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The objective of Canasta is to score points by forming melds (sets of three or more cards of the same rank) or canastas (melds of seven cards of the same rank).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basic rules of Canasta include: 
1. Each player is dealt a hand of 11 cards.
2. The remaining cards are placed in a draw pile, with the top card turned face up.
3. Players take turns either drawing the top card from the draw pile or picking up the entire discard pile (if they can use the top card to form a meld).
4. Players form melds by placing sets of three or more cards of the same rank on the table.
5. Players can add cards to existing melds.
6. A player can only form a meld after laying down a certain number of points in previous melds.
7. Jokers are wild and can be used as any rank.
8. When a player goes out, the hand ends, and the other players score points for cards still in their hands.
9. The game continues until one player or team reaches a certain number of points.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Canasta can be more complicated than this, but these are the basic rules.

[USER] Asks for made-up rules for a card game that does not exist.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Created a new card game titled "Color Clash" with the following details:
- Number of players: 2-6
- Deck: Standard 52-card deck
- Objective: Score points by creating sets of cards with matching colors.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gameplay for Color Clash includes:
1. Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player.
2. Players draw one card from the draw pile and play one card, declaring a color.
3. Players check for matching colors and must play all cards of that color.
4. If unable to play, a player draws one card, and their turn ends.
5. Play continues until the draw pile runs out, and players tally points based on cards played.
